datasets.name: headline
datasets.displayName: One row of headline numbers for the overview counters (dollars in USD so the cou
queryLines:
select
  (select effect_pct from workspace.nfip.results_pricing_adequacy
    where model = 'A_claim_frequency_per_class_step' and coefficient = 'class_steps')   as claims_per_step_pct,
  (select effect_pct from workspace.nfip.results_pricing_adequacy
    where model = 'A_loss_cost_per_class_step' and coefficient = 'class_steps')        as loss_cost_per_step_pct,

datasets.name: losses_by_year
datasets.displayName: Claims and paid losses by year, 2010 to 2024, filterable by state and CRS class.
queryLines:
with p as (
  select year, state, earned_policy_years, n_claims, paid_total,
         case when crs_status_basis = 'not_in_crs'            then 'Not in CRS'
              when crs_status_basis = 'participation_unknown' then 'Participation unknown'
              when crs_class is null                          then 'In CRS, class unknown'
              when crs_class <= 5                             then 'Class 1-5'
              else concat('Class ', cast(crs_class as int)) end as crs_group
  from workspace.nfip.gold_community_year_panel
  where year between 2010 and 2024
)
select year,
       sum(earned_policy_years)                                   as policy_years,
       sum(n_claims)                                              as claims,
       1000 * sum(n_claims) / sum(earned_policy_years)            as claims_per_1k_policy_years,
       sum(paid_total) / 1e9                                      as paid_busd
from p
where (size(:state) = 0 or array_contains(:state, state))
  and (size(:crs_group) = 0 or array_contains(:crs_group, crs_group))
group by year
order by year

datasets.name: state_map
datasets.displayName: Share of NFIP policy-years in CRS communities by state, 2022 to 2024.
queryLines:
with names as (
  select * from values
    ('AL', 'Alabama'), ('AK', 'Alaska'), ('AZ', 'Arizona'), ('AR', 'Arkansas'), ('CA', 'California'),
    ('CO', 'Colorado'), ('CT', 'Connecticut'), ('DE', 'Delaware'), ('DC', 'District of Columbia'),
    ('FL', 'Florida'), ('GA', 'Georgia'), ('HI', 'Hawaii'), ('ID', 'Idaho'), ('IL', 'Illinois'),
    ('IN', 'Indiana'), ('IA', 'Iowa'), ('KS', 'Kansas'), ('KY', 'Kentucky'), ('LA', 'Louisiana'),
    ('ME', 'Maine'), ('MD', 'Maryland'), ('MA', 'Massachusetts'), ('MI', 'Michigan'), ('MN', 'Minnesota'),
    ('MS', 'Mississippi'), ('MO', 'Missouri'), ('MT', 'Montana'), ('NE', 'Nebraska'), ('NV', 'Nevada'),
    ('NH', 'New Hampshire'), ('NJ', 'New Jersey'), ('NM', 'New Mexico'), ('NY', 'New York'),
    ('NC', 'North Carolina'), ('ND', 'North Dakota'), ('OH', 'Ohio'), ('OK', 'Oklahoma'), ('OR', 'Oregon'),
    ('PA', 'Pennsylvania'), ('RI', 'Rhode Island'), ('SC', 'South Carolina'), ('SD', 'South Dakota'),
    ('TN', 'Tennessee'), ('TX', 'Texas'), ('UT', 'Utah'), ('VT', 'Vermont'), ('VA', 'Virginia'),
    ('WA', 'Washington'), ('WV', 'West Virginia'), ('WI', 'Wisconsin'), ('WY', 'Wyoming')
    as t(state, state_name)
)
select n.state_name,
       round(100 * sum(case when p.crs_status_basis in ('current_class', 'in_crs_class_unknown')
                            then p.earned_policy_years else 0 end) / sum(p.earned_policy_years), 1) as crs_share_pct
from workspace.nfip.gold_community_year_panel p
join names n on n.state = p.state
where p.year between 2022 and 2024
group by n.state_name

datasets.name: class_decision
datasets.displayName: Pricing decision by CRS class: pooled relativity vs scheduled discount, and the
queryLines:
select concat('Class ', crs_bin)                                  as crs_class,
       round(pooled_effect_pct, 1)                                as pooled_loss_cost_effect_pct,
       round(pooled_low90_pct, 1)                                 as low90_pct,
       round(pooled_high90_pct, 1)                                as high90_pct,
       concat(format_number(pooled_effect_pct, 1), ' (', format_number(pooled_low90_pct, 1), ' to ',
              format_number(pooled_high90_pct, 1), ')')           as loss_cost_interval,
       round(scheduled_discount_pct, 1)                           as scheduled_discount_pct,
       round(-scheduled_discount_pct, 1)                          as break_even_pct,
       round(pooled_effect_pct + scheduled_discount_pct, 1)       as losses_above_discount_pts,
       round(100 * p_discount_too_generous, 0)                    as p_too_generous_pct,
       round(expected_gap_usd / 1e6, 1)                           as expected_gap_musd,
       round(expected_abs_gap_usd / 1e6, 1)                       as expected_abs_gap_musd,
       round(best_discount_pct, 1)                                as best_discount_pct,
       round(evpi_usd / 1e6, 1)                                   as evpi_musd,
       round(evsi_half_variance_usd / 1e6, 1)                     as evsi_half_variance_musd
from workspace.nfip.results_pricing_decision
order by crs_bin

datasets.name: discount_compare
datasets.displayName: Scheduled discount vs the discount that best fits current evidence, by CRS class
queryLines:
select concat('Class ', crs_bin) as crs_class, 'Scheduled' as discount_type,
       round(scheduled_discount_pct, 1) as discount_pct
from workspace.nfip.results_pricing_decision
union all
select concat('Class ', crs_bin), 'Best on current evidence', round(best_discount_pct, 1)
from workspace.nfip.results_pricing_decision

datasets.name: entry_design
datasets.displayName: Placebo simulation of the CRS entry difference-in-differences: detectable effect
queryLines:
select concat('Within county, ', replace(outcome, '_', ' '))      as design_outcome,
       n_entrants,
       round(mde_pct, 1)                                          as mde_pct
from workspace.nfip.results_c_power_design
where design = 'within_county'

datasets.name: entry_design_check
datasets.displayName: Placebo checks at the actual number of CRS entrants: why the year-fixed-effects
queryLines:
select case design when 'within_county' then 'Within county and year' else 'Year fixed effects only (original)' end
                                                                  as design,
       replace(outcome, '_', ' ')                                 as outcome,
       round(placebo_mean_pct, 1)                                 as bias_under_no_effect_pct,
       round(100 * false_positive_rate, 0)                        as false_positive_rate_pct,
       round(mde_pct, 1)                                          as mde_pct,
       case when design = 'within_county' then 'Kept, with placebo-calibrated errors' else 'Dropped: biased' end as verdict
from workspace.nfip.results_c_power_design
where n_entrants = (select min(n_entrants) from workspace.nfip.results_c_power_design)
order by design desc, outcome

datasets.name: experiment_power
datasets.displayName: Proposed randomized CRS recruitment trial: detectable drop in claims by design a
queryLines:
select concat(case assignment when 'within_county' then 'Within county' else 'Whole counties' end, ', ',
              replace(analysis, '_', ' '))                        as design,
       case size when 'all' then 'All eligible' else concat('~', size, ' pilot') end as trial_size,
       cast(n_communities as int)                                 as communities,
       round(itt_mde_pct, 1)                                      as itt_mde_pct,
       case when itt_mde_pct >= 90 then 'Not detectable' else format_number(itt_mde_pct, 1) end
                                                                  as itt_mde_label,
       case when complier_mde_pct_p50 >= 90 then 'Not detectable' else format_number(complier_mde_pct_p50, 1) end
                                                                  as complier_p50_label,
       case when complier_mde_pct_p25 >= 90 then 'Not detectable' else format_number(complier_mde_pct_p25, 1) end
                                                                  as complier_p25_label
from workspace.nfip.results_e_experiment_power
where outcome = 'n_claims'
order by cast(n_communities as int), design

datasets.name: pipeline_health
datasets.displayName: Quality checks from the latest job run, failures first, with failing rows as a s
queryLines:
with latest as (
  select * from workspace.nfip.ops_dq_results
  where run_at = (select max(run_at) from workspace.nfip.ops_dq_results)
),
check_tables as (
  select * from values ('claim_id_not_null', 'silver_nfip_claims'), ('state_is_two_letters', 'silver_nfip_claims'), ('paid_amounts_negative_adjustments', 'silver_nfip_claims'), ('year_of_loss_in_range', 'silver_nfip_claims'), ('crs_class_in_domain', 'silver_nfip_claims'), ('year_of_loss_matches_date', 'silver_nfip_claims'), ('community_id_six_chars', 'silver_nfip_claims'), ('missing_community_id', 'silver_nfip_claims'), ('construction_date_sentinel', 'silver_nfip_claims'), ('gold_mixed_crs_class_within_year', 'gold_community_year_claims'), ('status_book_crs_class_in_domain', 'silver_community_status'), ('exposure_non_negative', 'silver_policy_exposure_community_year'), ('panel_crs_class_in_domain', 'gold_community_year_panel'), ('panel_crs_status_basis_valid', 'gold_community_year_panel'), ('policy_crs_stamp_disagrees_with_history', 'gold_community_year_panel') as t(check_name, table_name)
),
table_counts as (
  select 'gold_community_year_claims' as table_name, count(*) as n from workspace.nfip.gold_community_year_claims
  union all
  select 'gold_community_year_panel' as table_name, count(*) as n from workspace.nfip.gold_community_year_panel
  union all
  select 'silver_community_status' as table_name, count(*) as n from workspace.nfip.silver_community_status
  union all
  select 'silver_nfip_claims' as table_name, count(*) as n from workspace.nfip.silver_nfip_claims
  union all
  select 'silver_policy_exposure_community_year' as table_name, count(*) as n from workspace.nfip.silver_policy_exposure_community_year
)
select l.check_name, l.layer, l.severity, l.failing_rows,
       case when l.passed then 'Passed' when l.severity = 'error' then 'Blocking' else 'Warning' end as status,
       round(100 * l.failing_rows / c.n, 2)                       as failing_share_pct,
       case when l.passed then 1 else 0 end                       as passed_flag,
       case when l.passed then 0 when l.severity = 'error' then 1 else 0 end as blocking,
       case when not l.passed and l.severity = 'warn' then 1 else 0 end      as warning,
       round((unix_timestamp(current_timestamp()) - unix_timestamp(l.run_at)) / 86400, 1) as days_since_run,
       (select count(distinct run_at) from workspace.nfip.ops_dq_results) as runs_recorded
from latest l
left join check_tables t on t.check_name = l.check_name
left join table_counts c on c.table_name = t.table_name
order by case when l.passed then 2 when l.severity = 'error' then 0 else 1 end, l.failing_rows desc, l.check_name

datasets.name: dq_history
datasets.displayName: Check outcomes per job run, for the run history chart.
queryLines:
select date_format(run_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')                    as run,
       case when passed then 'Passed' when severity = 'error' then 'Blocking' else 'Warning' end as status,
       count(*)                                                   as checks
from workspace.nfip.ops_dq_results
group by 1, 2
order by 1

queryLines:

lines:
# CRS flood discounts are right on average, but two of 5 classes get too much
Comparing communities in the same county and year, so they faced the same storms, each CRS class step cuts loss
cost 5.9% against a scheduled 5% discount. Class 7 and Class 9 are likely
over-discounted (85% and 94% probability). The evidence is thin, so better data is worth more than re-pricing:
about $96M a year.

335,000 NFIP community-years, 2010 to 2024. [Pipeline, methods, and caveats on GitHub](https://github.com/JacobWillson13/nfip-crs-measurement)

lines:
## Pricing decision by CRS class
Class relativities are partially pooled in a Bayesian hierarchical model, with uncertainty widened by placebo
tests. **Net gap** is premium at the scheduled discount minus expected loss: negative means the discount is too
generous. It can disagree with the probability (Class 1-5 is 52% likely too generous yet
+$23.9M net) because the loss estimate is skewed. **Abs. gap** sums to the overview's
$364M. Re-pricing on today's evidence barely shrinks it; better data (recovering historical CRS
classes) is worth far more.

frame.description: Best discount minimizes the expected absolute gap; below zero is a surcharge

lines:
## Can the causal effect of joining CRS be measured?
**Left:** placebo simulations of the entry difference-in-differences, comparing communities within the same county
and year. The original design (year fixed effects only) was dropped: with no true effect it reported
+41% and flagged fake effects 25% of the time (table below). Even the fixed
design detects only large effects. **Right:** a proposed randomized recruitment trial. It can measure whether
outreach raises participation, but not a realistic effect on claims.

frame.title: Observational design: detectable effect
frame.description: Joining CRS usually starts at Class 9 or 8, a 5 to 10% discount

frame.title: Randomized trial: detectable drop in claims
frame.description: Realistic offer effect: 25% uptake x 20% fewer claims among joiners = 5%

frame.title: Design check at the 395 actual entrants
frame.description: Placebo entry dates given to communities that never joined: a sound design reports about 0%. Reported standard errors still overstate significance, so detectable effects use the placebo spread.

frame.title: Trial power
frame.description: Drops of 90% or more are shown as not detectable
